description: This Java class 'ExternalAssetOwnersSearchApiDelegate' implements the 'ExternalAssetOwnersSearchApi' interface, providing a method to search for investor data related to external asset owners using a search service. It is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.investor.api.search' package and utilizes Spring's dependency injection.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnersSearchApiDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class implementing the API for searching external asset owner data, acting as a bridge to the search service.

methods.name: searchInvestorData
methods.description: Handles the search request by delegating to the ExternalAssetOwnerSearchService to retrieve a page of ExternalTransferData.
